messages:
cheng: Heads-up — we need a minimal, auditable per-tenant routing ACL for enterprise customers so we can route certain orgs to Dedicated clusters or alternate model variants without touching global rules. Thinking header-based match (X-Org-ID) + precedence + a safe fallback. Any strong objections?
sasha: 👍 need to know how this interacts with region routing and account-scoped pins. precedence matters a lot.
aj: No objections. Proposal: treat per-tenant ACLs as higher precedence than generic route rules but lower than emergency breakglass. Also TTL for cached decisions. Sketch of config:```
match:
  header: X-Org-ID
  equals: "acme-enterprise"
action:
  target: dedicated-acme
  fallback: hosted-lowlatency
  audit: true
  ttl_secs: 300
```
maria: We should store the ACL entry in org metadata so product + security can see history. Audit events for every match + UI diff for changes. Also enforce an approvals flow for org-scoped routing changes.
devex-bot: Suggestion: show 'effective route' preview in Console for a given example request (headers + region + model). Small UX: an input box + a table of matched rules.
cheng: Good. Also need to think about quotas: routed-to Dedicated may not be covered by org's hosted quota; billing-ops, can you flag concerns?
billing-ops: If an org is routed to Dedicated, we need a mapping to billing contracts. Avoid silent cost surprises. We'll require an explicit contract ID in the ACL meta or the router should attach a billing tag.
sasha: Cache invalidation note — when someone edits ACLs via Console we must invalidate prefix/KV caches quickly for that org, else traffic keeps going to old target for up to ttl_secs. Maybe publish an invalidation event on the control plane bus.
aj: Rate-limiter interaction: per-tenant ACLs should be matched before rate-limiter lookup so we can apply per-target rate policies. If we do match after, we lose per-target quota granularity.
maria: Security: only allow org-admins + security contacts to request routing changes; ops or SRE must approve for Dedicated route assignments. Require two-person approval in Console for promoted rules.
cheng: Implementation plan I propose: 1) add rule matcher that accepts header/claim/cookie; 2) precedence engine (breakglass > tenant-acl > global-route > region-default); 3) audit + billing tag; 4) Console CRUD with approval workflow + preview. I'll open an RFC and break into tasks.
infra-bot: CI PR created: platform/router#654 (draft) — includes matcher + unit tests.
aj: Nice. One more: what about non-ASCII org IDs and casing? normalize to lowercase and forbid funny chars in UI.
maria: Also add a dry-run flag on apply so partner engineers can test routing without flipping traffic.
devex-bot: UX followups: show an 'impact estimate' (requests/hr matched historically) and a small link to model/regional dashboards. Helps with approvals.
cheng: Great. I'll add owners: cheng (impl), sasha (cache/invalidations), aj (rate-limit), maria (security/console), billing-ops (billing mapping). Will post RFC by EOD. :thumbsup:
